pages.text: Energy Liquefier: crushes solid akaishi energy down into 'Nether energy liquid'.$(br)Don't ask how energy fits in a can — the answer is always 'akaishi tech, that's how'. Each tick it gulps energy and spits liquid, purer than a lab beaker.

Energy Processor: solid matter + Nether energy liquid, stirred into burnable fuel.$(br)Think of it as akaishi 'liquid bread' — solids in one side, liquid in the other, and out pops hard currency for your reactor.

Fluid Tanks come in three tiers:$(li)Basic: for the homestead$(li)Advanced: for the workshop$(li)Super: until you question your life choices$(br)They store Nether energy / fuel liquid. Hook up a pipe and the liquid finds its own way home.

Fluid Pipe: hauls liquid around, more reliable than any courier and never loses a package.$(br)Pair it with tanks, the liquefier and the processor to build a fully automatic liquid-fuel assembly line.
